title: Restricted scalar extension as a sheaf tensor product
statement: For a morphism phi:R to S of sheaves of commutative rings on a small site, and an R-module sheaf M [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], restriction of scalar extension S tensor_R M is isomorphic to the sheaf tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] of the restricted regular S-module and M. Here scalar extension is the sheafification of sectionwise scalar extension, and restriction is [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. On every local pure tensor s tensor m the isomorphism sends its image under the tensor sheafification unit to its image under the scalar-extension sheafification unit.

source.place: Tag 03EK (tensor product of module sheaves), Tag 03CY (module sheafification)

proof.text: The section modules of the presheaf tensor and the restricted scalar extension are identical. Their restriction maps agree on pure tensors and hence on all tensors by induction, giving a presheaf-module isomorphism.

Restriction commutes with module sheafification: the canonical comparison becomes the identity after forgetting to abelian sheaves, and the forgetful functor reflects isomorphisms. Compose with the tensor-sheafification isomorphism. Naturality of the sheafification unit proves the asserted formula on local pure tensors. The same unit naturality proves the first-factor map formula. Composing with the regular presheaf tensor unitor and the sheafification counit gives the explicit regular tensor unitor, whose inverse has formula m maps to 1 tensor m by the triangle identity.
